import tarfile
tar = tarfile.open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb/jpg.tar.gz')

    if member.name.endswith('.jpg'):
        f = tar.extractfile(member)
        data = f.read()
        # Find SOF marker
        for i in range(len(data)-1):
            if data[i] == 0xff and data[i+1] == 0xc0:
                print(f'File: {member.name}')
                print(f'SOF0 at offset {i}')
                print(f'SOF0 data: {data[i:i+20].hex()}')
                print(f'Image size: {data[i+5]}x{data[i+7]} bits, {data[i+9]} components')
                offset = i + 11
                for c in range(data[i+9]):
                    comp_id = data[offset]
                    sampling = data[offset+1]
                    h = sampling >> 4
                    v = sampling & 0x0f
                    tq = data[offset+2]
                    print(f'  Component {c}: id={comp_id}, h={h}, v={v}, tq={tq}')
                    offset += 3
                break
        break
